question: Devprayag is the confluence of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Alaknanda and Bhagirathi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Devprayag:**

 
 
• It is also known as Devi prayāga, is a town and nagar panchayat located in the **Tehri Garhwal District** of **Uttarakhand**, India.
 
• It is the** last of the five confluences, or Panch Prayags.**
 
• It is the **place where Alaknanda River meets the Bhagirathi River, and both rivers continue as the Ganges River, also known as Ganga.**
 
• The Alaknanda rises in Uttarakhand, close to the Tibetan border, at the meeting point and base of the Satopanth
 
• The Gangotri and Khatling glaciers in the Garhwal Himalaya are the sources of the Bhagirathi's headwaters, which are produced at Gaumukh.
 
• **In Devprayag, these two holy rivers converge to form the Ganges (Ganga).**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Yamuna:**

 
 
• It is the **largest tributary of the Ganges **and **meets the Ganges at Allahabad in Uttar Pradesh, India.**
 
• The confluence of the **Yamuna and Ganges is known as the Triveni Sangam.**
 
 
 
• **Sutlej:**
 
 
• It** **is a river that flows through **India and Pakistan.**
 
• It is tributary of Indus. It meets the **Indus river** in **Pakistan.**
 
 
 
• **Godavari:**
 
 
• It is a river that flows through the states of **Maharashtra, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, and Odisha** in India.
 
• It is also known as **Dakshin Ganga**.
 
• It flows into **Bay of Bengal.**
 
 
 
• **Narmada:**
 
 
• **It** is a river that flows through the states of **Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra, and Gujarat** in India.
 
• It flows into **Arabian sea.**
